senses.gloss: अदैन्य a. Involving no humiliation or self-degradation Bh. 3. 144.

अदैव a. (-वी f.)
—1 Not predestined or predetermined (by Gods or by Fate).
—2 Not connected with the Gods or their action, not divine; अदैवं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धम्
 Ms. 3. 247 (Kull. वैश्वदेवब्राह्मणभोजनरहितम्).
—3 Unfortunate, ill-fated.
